summary: Iteration 3 regression verification after code review corrections (is None idiom, useCallback deps, SECURITY.md). Backend smoke tests for all 3 roles + key endpoints pass. Frontend buyer login flow works end-to-end; dashboard renders with real data. Security architecture verified: auth tokens are httpOnly cookies, localStorage contains only PostHog analytics (no tokens).
passed: POST /api/auth/login buyer@test.com → 200, sets httpOnly access_token + refresh_token cookies
GET /api/auth/me with cookie → 200 returns correct user payload
GET /api/seller/subscription (seller auth) → 200 returns free plan w/ bid_limit=5
Login UI redirects buyer to /buyer/dashboard after successful login
Buyer dashboard renders real data (Welcome Test Buyer, demands count, offers)
SECURITY: access_token cookie HttpOnly=true, refresh_token cookie HttpOnly=true
SECURITY: localStorage contains only ph_...posthog key — NO auth tokens stored
No JS pageerror events; no visible .error elements on dashboard
No infinite render loop observed (dashboard stable, data fetched once)
notes: Two console 401s on /api/auth/me are expected pre-login checks from AuthContext when /login mounts without cookies; cleared after successful login.
cf_clearance and __cf_bm cookies are from Cloudflare, unrelated to app auth.
